summary: (iv) Order dated 15.11.2018 in Petition No. 88/MP/2018 read with read with Judgment of the Hon’ble Tribunal dated 16.07.2021 in Appeal No. 342 of 2019 and Judgment of Hon’ble Supreme Court dated 03.03.2023 in Civil Appeal No. 684 of 2021 & Batch; (v) Order dated 18.12.2019 in Petition No. 39/MP/2019; and (vi) Order dated 02.04.2019 in Petition No. 71/MP/2018. (c) In the interim, direct DNH to pay 75% of the outstanding amount due and payable to GWEL. (d) Pass an order for attachment of bank account of Respondent DNH or any other suitable measure/directions to ensure compliance and implementation of Orders passed by this Commission as confirmed by the Tribunal and Hon’ble Supreme Court; (e) Initiate proceedings under Section 142 of the Electricity Act against Respondent, DNH for failure to comply with the directions of this Hon’ble Commission; and (f) Pass any such further order as this Commission may deem necessary in the interest of justice.” 5. During the course of hearing on 11.8.2026, the learned counsels for the Petitioner and the Respondent, DNHPDCL, stated that they are in the process of settlement of all the outstanding dues/claims amongst them and accordingly, requested for deferment of the matters. Based on the consent of the parties, the matters were adjourned for 5.11.2026. 6. On 3.9.2026, the Petitions were mentioned by the learned counsels for the Petitioner as well as the Respondent, DNHPDCL, and submitted that they have filed their respective memo(s) and have agreed to settlement amount to be paid to the Petitioner towards full and final discharge of all pending claims in both Petitions. Based on the request of DNHPDCL, the Commission granted additional time of 10 days for the payment of the admitted amounts and also directed DNHPDCL to file a compliance affidavit thereof. Accordingly, both the matters were reserved for order. Order in Petition No. 126/MP/2022 & Petition No. 247/MP/2023 Page 4 5. That it is therefore respectfully submitted that the present matters may kindly be disposed of in terms of the above compliance.” 8. The Petitioner has also acknowledged the receipt of the admitted amount of Rs. 301 crore (Three hundred one crore) as full and final payment of all claims vide letter dated 17.9.2026. The relevant excerpts of the acknowledgement are as under: “Dated: 17th September 2026 Ref No.: GWEL/DNHDDPCL/2026/166 To, Mr. Sourabh Maheshwari Deputy Manager (Accounts) DNH and DD Power Corporation Limited (formerly DNH Power Distribution Corporation Limited) Subject: Acknowledgment of receipt of payment of Rs. 301,00,00,000/- (Rupees Three Hundred One Crore only) towards full and final discharge of claims under the Power Purchase Agreement dated 21.03.2013, pursuant to Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by DNH and Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by GWEL before CERC in Petition No. 126/MP/2022 and Petition No. 247/MP/2023. References: (a) Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by. DNH (b) Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by GWEL (c) RoP dated 03.09.2026 passed by CERC Dear Sir, 1. We refer to the Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by DNH and DD Power Corporation Limited (formerly DNH Power Distribution Corporation Limited) ("DNH") before the Hon'ble Central Electricity Regulatory Commission ("CERC") in the above-referred Petitions, admitting its liability to the extent of Rs. 301,00,00,000/- (Rupees Three Hundred One Crore only) towards the claims raised by GMR Warora Energy Limited ("GWEL"), and to the Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by GWEL in response thereto, as well as the Record of Proceedings (ROP) dated 03.09.2026 passed by CERC in the above Petitions. 2. In this regard, we hereby acknowledge receipt of payment of Rs. 301,00,00,000/- (Rupees Three Hundred One Crore only) made by DH, from which an amount of Rs. 2,13,20,860/- (Rupees Two Crore Thirteen Lakh Twenty Thousand Eight Hundred Sixty only) has been deducted towards TDS, resulting in a net amount of Rs. 2,98,86,79,140/- (Rupees Two Hundred Ninety-Eight Crore Eighty-Six Lakh Seventy-Nine Thousand One Hundred Forty only) having been credited to the account of GWEL on 16.09.2026. Order in Petition No. 126/MP/2022 & Petition No. 247/MP/2023 Page 6 3. The aforesaid payment has been made pursuant to and in terms of the Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by DNH and the Memo dated 26.08.2026 filed by GWEL before CERC and constitutes full and final payment/discharge of all claims of GWEL against DNH under the PPA. 4. As agreed between the parties, DNH shall withdraw the remaining appeal viz. Appeal No. 80 of 2022 (DNH v. CERC & Anr.), pending before the Hon'ble Appellate Tribunal for Electricity by filing an appropriate application for withdrawal of the Appeal at the earliest”. 9. We have considered the submissions of the learned counsels of the parties and perused the documents on record. It is noted that the issues in these Petitions stand amicably settled between the parties on payment of admitted amount to the Petitioner by the Respondent, DNHPDCL. Both the parties have admitted that no claims or the grievance in these matters survive. Accordingly, Petition No. 126/MP/2022 along with IA No. 41/2022 and Petition No. 247/MP/2023 are disposed of in terms of the above.
